main_text.l: te malitiam doctrinæ nequam :) vel vt Lu-
therus vertit: Dann solch hart aufffehen bringt
nichts guts, h.e. ne malis artibus tibi infidiari
incipiat, & nouissima illius experiaris amara
quasi absynthium: ne exerceat contra te arti-
ficium muliebre nequam, edocta ab impro-
bis. Etenim si proba est, nimium arceri non
debet: si improba, custodiri non poterit, pro-
ficiet potius de malo in peius, dicente Hie-
ronymo: Quid prodest diligens custodia, qu-
um vxor seruari impudica non possit, pudi-
ca non debeat? Infida enim custos castitatis
est necessitas: & illa verè pudica dicenda est,
cui licuit peccare, sed noluit. Huc & illud
Germanorum pertinet: Oder es hilfft nicht/
oder es darff sich nicht. Adde quòd zelus, si-
cut iracundia & tristitia minuunt dies, & an-
te tempus senectam adducit cura, Eccles. 20.
Vulgus quoque non improprie hunc affe-
ctum gelosiam vocat, quod animum assiduo
metu territet adeo, vt continua suspicionum
recurfatione gelu quodam sanguis ipse con-
crescat (teste Iouiano lib. 3. de Obed. 6.) quæ
solicitudo quanquam multarum in se habe-
at discordiarum semina, raroque gratia in
illa esse domo potest, in qua radices altiores
egerit: origo tamen eius ab amore est, qui me-
tu ac suspicione victus, diffidensque ac paui-
tans, & nunc dolore, nunc ira percitus, men-
tem adeo perturbat, & animum concutit, vt
eius ferri vix possit impotentia. Quocirca
fugiendus est is animi morbus, & solicitudi-

page.notes: Running head read as NVPTIALES from spaced capitals. Page number reads as 211 but the last digit is uncertain. Black-letter passages (Luther quotation and the German proverb) are transcribed from the scan and may contain misread letters, especially "solch" and "aufffehen", where the printed long s and ff ligature are hard to tell apart. The line "Ööer" at the start of the German proverb is read as "Oder". The text is one paragraph, continuing from the previous page; no indent or short line marks a new paragraph on this page. The text ends mid-word at "solicitudi-", and no catchword is printed.
